title: Docusaurus Command Center parallel watch-and-steer video
description: Recipe-owned capture for the first public-safe Docusaurus demo video: Command Center monitoring allowed real Farmslot runs in parallel while the operator steers visible terminals.

prepare-stage.intent: Stage or select public-safe Farmslot demo runs for Command Center capture.

open-command-center.intent: Open Command Center with the allowed-project filter applied.

verify-safe-view.intent: Verify multiple allowed terminal panes are visible and forbidden private labels are absent.

record-proof-window.intent: Record the short Command Center proof window while steer-demo-panes sends visible terminal input.

steer-demo-panes.intent: While recording, send safe visible terminal commands and an operator prompt to show live steering.

publish-artifacts.intent: Publish the MP4, poster, pre/post screenshots, trace, summary, and artifact manifest.
